up: Return 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL1293266 (Nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-containing protein 2) with standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_relation = '='. Include only rows with a non-null pChEMBL value. For each row, return the following columns: assay.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, and activities.pchembl_value. Order the results by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id and then by assay.chembl_id.
sql:
SELECT
  assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  activities.standard_type,
  activities.pchembl_value
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293266'
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.standard_relation = '='
  AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
